description_en: Queries a list of resources that are aggregated across regions in the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 获取当前账号下跨地域聚合的资源列表信息
name: ListDiscoveredResources

parameters.help_en:
The status of the resource. Valid values:

0: The resource is deleted. If you delete a resource in the corresponding Alibaba Cloud service, Cloud Config displays the resource as Deleted.

1 (Default): The resource is active. If a resource is managed, Cloud Config displays the resource as Active
parameters.help_zh:
资源状态。取值：

0：已删除。如果您已在目标云产品中删除某个资源，则在配置审计的资源列表中显示该资源为已删除。
1（默认值）：保有中。如果您的资源被正常管理，则在配置审计的资源列表中显示该资源为保有中
parameters.name: resource_deleted

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource resides. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属的地域ID。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en: A pagination token. If the response is truncated, use this token in a subsequent request to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query resources, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Note:

The value cannot be later than EndUpdateTimestamp.

The time interval between StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp cannot exceed 30 days.

Specify both StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp, or leave both blank
parameters.help_zh:
资源时间范围查询的开始时间，采用标准UTC时间戳。取值限制：
必须是毫秒时间戳。
不能大于EndUpdateTimestamp，且与EndUpdateTimestamp间隔范围小于等于30天。
StartUpdateTimestamp与EndUpdateTimestamp必须同时填写或同时不填写
parameters.name: start_update_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query resources, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Note:

The value cannot be earlier than StartUpdateTimestamp.

The time interval between StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp cannot exceed 30 days.

Specify both StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp, or leave both blank
parameters.help_zh:
资源时间范围查询的截止时间，采用标准UTC时间戳。取值限制：
必须是毫秒时间戳。
不能小于StartUpdateTimestamp，且与StartUpdateTimestamp间隔范围小于等于30天。
StartUpdateTimestamp与EndUpdateTimestamp必须同时填写或同时不填写
parameters.name: end_update_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The resource types to exclude. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,). This parameter takes precedence over the ResourceTypes parameter
parameters.help_zh: 排除的资源类型，多资源类型用逗号分隔，与ResourceTypes字段冲突时，该字段具有更高优先级
parameters.name: exclude_resource_types

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 资源拥有者的阿里云账号ID

AvailabilityZone.description_en: The availability zone of the resource

ResourceCreationTime.description_en: The time when the resource was created. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ResourceCreationTime.description_zh: 资源创建时间戳。单位：毫秒

ResourceDeleted.description_en:
The status of the resource. Valid values:

0: Deleted.

1: Active
ResourceDeleted.description_zh:
资源状态。取值：
0：已删除。
1：保有中

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the resource belongs. Example: rg-acfmvoh45rhxxxx
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 资源所属的资源组ID，例如：rg-acfmvoh45rhxxxx
ResourceGroupId.title_en: 资源所属的资源组ID，例如：rg-acfmvoh45rhxxxx
ResourceGroupId.title_zh: 资源所属的资源组ID，例如：rg-acfmvoh45rhxxxx

ResourceStatus.description_en:
The status of the resource. The status is defined by the corresponding Alibaba Cloud service. This parameter can be empty. For example:

If the resource type is ACS::ECS::Instance, the resource is stateful. The value can be Running or Stopped.

If the resource type is ACS::OSS::Bucket, the resource is stateless. The value is empty
ResourceStatus.description_zh:
资源状态。资源的状态取决于各云服务对其的定义，该参数可能为空。例如：
当资源类型为ACS::ECS::Instance时，由于ECS实例有状态，因此该参数为Running或Stopped。
当资源类型为ACS::OSS::Bucket时，由于OSS Bucket无状态，因此该参数为空

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was last updated. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 资源的最近一次更新时间，毫秒级时间戳

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the resource belongs. Multiple vSwitch IDs are separated by commas (,). An empty string ("") is returned if the resource does not belong to a vSwitch
VSwitchId.description_zh: 所属的 vSwitch ID，格式：vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，多值时逗号分隔，如 vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，无所属VSWITCH时返回为空字符串：""
VSwitchId.title_en: 所属的 vSwitch ID，格式：vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，多值时逗号分隔，如 vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，无所属VSWITCH时返回为空字符串：""
VSwitchId.title_zh: 所属的 vSwitch ID，格式：vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，多值时逗号分隔，如 vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，无所属VSWITCH时返回为空字符串：""

Version.description_en: The version of the resource change

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the resource belongs. An empty string ("") is returned if the resource does not belong to a VPC
VpcId.description_zh: 所属的 vpc ID，格式：vpc-t4nhheyvay74fp7n0hxxx，无所属VPC时返回空字符串: ""
VpcId.title_en: 所属的 vpc ID，格式：vpc-t4nhheyvay74fp7n0hxxx，无所属VPC时返回空字符串: ""
VpcId.title_zh: 所属的 vpc ID，格式：vpc-t4nhheyvay74fp7n0hxxx，无所属VPC时返回空字符串: ""

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned on each page

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
